say:1:1230298001:0.text: No need to question who I am or where I come from, young one.
say:1:1230298001:0.source_cn: 年轻人，不必问我的身份和来历。
say:1:1230298001:0.male: No need to question who I am or where I come from, young one.
say:1:1230298001:0.female: No need to question who I am or where I come from, young one.

say:2:1230298002:0.text: Inside this chest, I've got treasures beyond your wildest dreams! But if you want them, you'll need to win a honor duel!
say:2:1230298002:0.source_cn: 菲茨叔叔的箱子里可有不少好东西，想要的话就来一局荣誉对决吧！

say:3:1230298003:0.text: I'll be right here, witnessing every thrilling moment of each honor duel!
